beats.say: Your app is running. But is it working?
A process can be alive and stuck. Kubernetes cannot know, unless you tell it.
beats.label: The gap
beats.head: Alive, but stuck

beats.say: This port has three tools: probes, resource limits, and autoscaling.
beats.label: Port 6 · Health and scaling

check.prompt: A pod needs 30 seconds to warm up. Which probe keeps traffic away until then?
check.why: A pod that fails readiness is removed from the Service. It is not restarted.

beats.say: First: let the cluster ask your app.
Readiness asks: can you serve now? If not, the pod gets no traffic.
beats.label: Readiness
beats.head: Not ready: no traffic

beats.say: Liveness asks: are you stuck? If yes, the container restarts.
beats.label: Liveness
beats.head: Stuck: restart

beats.say: Never check the database in a liveness probe. One slow database restarts every pod.
beats.label: The trap
beats.head: No dependencies in liveness

check.prompt: A container uses more memory than its limit. What happens?
check.why: Memory cannot be squeezed. The container is killed with exit code 137.

beats.say: Second: how much may a pod take?
A request reserves capacity. The scheduler uses it to place the pod.
beats.label: Request
beats.head: The scheduler reads requests

beats.say: Over the processor limit, you are slowed down. Over the memory limit, you are killed.
beats.label: Limit
beats.head: CPU: throttled. Memory: killed.

beats.say: An autoscaler watches the processor use, and adds or removes pods.
beats.label: Pod autoscaler
beats.head: More load, more pods

beats.say: No room for the new pods? A node autoscaler adds machines.
beats.label: Node autoscaler
beats.head: Pending pods bring new nodes

beats.say: Readiness gates traffic. Liveness restarts. And memory over the limit is killed.
beats.label: Health and scaling

beats.say: Now start the first lesson below.
